top_stories.title: Astronauts Briefly Take Shelter After Leak On Space Station Triggers Safety Alert
top_stories.rephrased_article: **NASA** and **Roscosmos**, the two primary operators of the International Space Station, responded to a worsening air leak aboard the station.  Five astronauts from the **Crew-12** mission sheltered in their SpaceX-built Crew Dragon spacecraft for approximately two hours after NASA ordered them to do so on Friday. The leaks were initially sealed and repairs are underway on the second leak. While no immediate threat was identified, NASA reversed its shelter order after assessing the air leak rate.

top_stories.title: ‘Inquilab Zindabad… Satta ke galiyaron mein’: At CJP’s first protest, youngsters gather outside Parliament Street station | Delhi News - The Indian Express
top_stories.rephrased_article: A protest organized by the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) gathered outside Parliament Street police station in Delhi.  **Saurav Das**, a founder of CJP, arrived at the station and was surrounded by cameras. **Abhishek Dipke**, another CJP founder, secured permission for a protest at Jantar Mantar. The protesters are demanding the resignation of Education Minister **Dharmendra Pradhan**.

top_stories.title: Assam cabinet Hikes Dearness Allowance To 60 percent, Over 8 Lakh Employees, pensioners To Benefit
top_stories.rephrased_article: The **Assam** Cabinet approved a 2-percentage-point increase in Dearness Allowance (DA) and Dearness Relief (DR) for state government employees, raising it from 58% to 60%. The cabinet also increased the MLA Local Area Development (MLALAD) allocation from Rs 1 crore to Rs 1.5 crore per MLA for FY 2026-27 and Rs 2 crore from FY 2027-28. Additionally, **Assam** declared Dibrugarh as its Second State Capital Region with a new Development Authority.

top_stories.title: Over 3,500 Indians deported From US In 2025, More Than 1,000 This Year, Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) said
top_stories.rephrased_article: **The Ministry of External Affairs (MEA)** reported that a total of 1,076 Indian nationals have been deported from the US this year. This follows a trend where **3,567** Indians were deported in 2025 as part of intensified efforts by the US government to target illegal migrants.  The **US** and **India** are working together on issues related to deportation, migration, and mobility.

top_stories.title: India's 'Huge Responsibility' Reminder To Pakistan Over J&K Remark At UN
top_stories.rephrased_article: **India's** Permanent Representative to the UN, P Harish, strongly condemned **Pakistan's** plan for June 7th elections in Gilgit-Baltistan, calling them "false and biased narratives" and reiterating that Jammu and Kashmir is an integral part of India.  Harish warned **Pakistan** against using the UN platform for divisive political interests during a General Assembly session. **India** also lodged a protest with the Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) stating that the region is illegally occupied by Pakistan, highlighting human rights violations and economic exploitation.

top_stories.title: India's 'Huge Responsibility' Reminder To Pakistan Over J&K Remark At UN
top_stories.rephrased_article: **India's** Permanent Representative to the UN, P Harish, strongly condemned **Pakistan's** plan for June 7th elections in Gilgit-Baltistan, calling them "baseless" and a misuse of the UN platform.  Harish reiterated that **Jammu and Kashmir** is an integral part of India and any claims to the contrary are without historical basis. He also reminded **Pakistan** of its responsibility as a member of the UN Security Council. The Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) lodged a protest against Pakistan's actions, asserting that Gilgit-Baltistan is Indian territory illegally occupied by Pakistan.

top_stories.title: US Iran War Live Updates: Kuwait Responds To Missile, Drone Attacks, Sirens Sounded In Bahrain
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Iran** launched seven ballistic missiles and drones toward **Kuwait** and **Bahrain**, hours after reports of four "one-way attack" drones being thwarted.  The US military intercepted six of the missiles, with one failing to reach its target. President **Donald Trump** stated that the situation with Iran is going well, claiming they are left with 21% of their missiles. The US has authorized a $1.98 billion arms sale to **Kuwait**, and announced it will be providing counter-drone technology from defense company Anduril.

top_stories.title: Arrests of critics in Ghana provokes alarm over free speech under Mahama | News | Al Jazeera
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Ghana's** government has been accused of escalating its crackdown on online dissent, with 14 arrests linked to false news and offensive speech in the past 16 months. **President John Mahama**, who previously warned against using state power to stifle dissent, is now facing criticism for his government's actions.  Opposition leaders argue that these arrests represent a dangerous trend towards restricting free speech, while supporters of the government maintain that they are simply enforcing existing laws in a changing digital landscape. The debate highlights concerns about the balance between upholding democratic values and addressing harmful online content.

top_stories.title: Minister Ramalinga Reddy’s resignation issue resolved, says Chief Minister Shivakumar - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **D.K. Shivakumar**, **Karnataka Chief Minister**, resolved a crisis triggered by **Ramalinga Reddy's** resignation over portfolio allocation after marathon discussions with the senior Congress leader.  The meeting, lasting nearly two-and-a-half hours, involved senior Congress leaders and some of **Reddy's** close associates.  **Shivakumar** stated that the issue was a case of miscommunication and assured that everything would be sorted out.

top_stories.title: Cockroach Kingpin In Australia Caught With 1,00,000 Illegal Insects In Record Bust
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Australia's Department of Climate Change, Energy, Environment and Water** seized over 100,000 live Madagascar hissing cockroaches and dubia cockroaches in a single bust from a breeder in Bathurst, New South Wales. The seizure, worth $142,000, was the largest invertebrate bust in Australia's history and highlights the illegal import of exotic species despite strict biosecurity laws. Officials warned that these larger cockroaches could spread disease or harm native wildlife and urged pet owners to use legal alternatives for reptile food.
